class.name: SmartObjectSlotReservations
class.brief_description: Server-owned, exclusive smart-object slot reservations with bounded leases and deterministic preference order.
class.description: A data-only claim allocator inspired by Unreal Engine Smart Objects slots. Intended for a server to allocate independently validated interaction positions among agents without sharing the same slot. Claimants provide 1 to 16 unique positive slot IDs in preference order, a positive actor ID, and a finite lease duration from zero (exclusive) to 5 seconds. A maximum of 2,048 actor claims can coexist; each actor may own at most one slot, with a claim renewed in place if the same slot is still among requested candidates. Failed claims never revoke existing claims. A priority-aware variant may preempt lower-priority claimed but unoccupied slots; only the owner may mark occupancy. The caller advances lease time explicitly and controls all positions, tags, eligibility, authoritative movement, and damage. There are no scene-tree, collision, or networking calls.

method.name: try_claim_first
method.description: Returns an exclusively claimed slot ID, or zero if all requested slots are occupied or any argument is invalid. Reclaims an actor-owned candidate first even when not ranked first, and renews its lease; otherwise atomically transfers the actor to the first unoccupied candidate. Candidate count 1 to 16, lease (0, 5] seconds, positive unique slot IDs and actor IDs required.

method.name: try_claim_first_priority
method.description: Attempts to renew an actor-owned slot, then a free slot, then preempts a strictly lower-priority (0 to 3) CLAIMED but not OCCUPIED candidate. Occupied slots and equal or higher priorities cannot be preempted. Returns zero if all candidates are blocked or any input is invalid, without losing an actor's existing claim.

method.name: refresh_claim
method.description: O(1) cached Smart Object lease heartbeat using indexed slot and actor lookup. Atomically validates both positive IDs, current exact owner/slot identity, and a finite lease in (0, 5] seconds; only on success renews the lease and marks the slot occupied or unoccupied. Returns false without changing anything when a cached claim has expired, been preempted, released or is owned by someone else, or if any argument is invalid. A true occupied slot cannot be preempted by any priority; clearing occupation allows the existing strict priority rule again. Repeated heartbeats prevent expiry only when actively issued by the authoritative server; abandoned slots still expire through [method advance_time], even if previously marked occupied. Does not move agents, perform collision queries, or change slot priority. Designed for Unreal-style claim/use lifecycle where a tactical AI reuses an already planned destination without re-running EQS.

method.name: set_slot_occupied
method.description: Only the current owner can mark a claimed slot as actively occupied or return it to a preemptible claimed state. Returns true for an authorized update; expired or transferred claims cannot be modified by the former owner.

method.name: is_slot_occupied
method.description: Returns true only when a live slot claim has been marked occupied. A free slot returns false.

method.name: release_slot
method.description: Only the actor owning the slot may release it. Returns whether that reservation was removed.

method.name: release_actor
method.description: Removes all claims held by an actor (normally zero or one). Useful for explicit despawn cleanup.

method.name: advance_time
method.description: Advances leases once per authoritative simulation tick. Ignores invalid or nonpositive deltas.

method.name: get_owner
method.description: Returns the owner actor ID, or zero if this slot is free.

method.name: get_actor_slot
method.description: Returns an actor's currently claimed slot ID, or zero if absent. Uses the engine's indexed claim lookup. A cached AI goal may be reused only while its slot is still owned; this read does not claim or renew a slot.

method.name: get_claim_count
method.description: Returns the active claim count (at most 2048).

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all reservations. No client state or saved data are changed.
